Delete your Mural account and forfeit any unused free minutes? Your learning data stays on this device. Records needed for billing or trial eligibility may be retained.
Send a deletion request from your Mural account email. Support will verify ownership and review any balance or pending payment. Your account stays active until deletion is completed.
Opening your email app prepares a draft. Send it to submit your request. Do not include passwords, API keys or conversation exports.
